title: Define Dashboard automation admission contract
prohibited_actions: No deployment trigger, background scheduler, credential, database, network service, or ObserverOS authority change
No GitHub mutation beyond normal governed OTP Issue/PR/receipt workflow
No implementation of a local automation adapter
acceptance: Contract version-locks the offline OTP-to-Issue-to-PR-to-receipt state machine
Contract defines fail-closed malformed, replay and invalid transition behavior
Verification proves no scheduler, network primitive, credential or deployment action
Typecheck, production build, control-plane validation, GitHub audit, and receipt pass
